Subject: Postdoc position: Integrated population modelling of African penguins
 
Dear all,

We have a funded 2-year postdoc position in quantitative ecology available at SEEC (The Centre for Statistics in Ecology, Environment and Conservation) at the University of Cape Town in South Africa. The postdoc will be responsible for the development of capture-recapture and integrated population models to assess the efficacy of conservation measures for African penguins. The project is in collaboration with SANCCOB (the Southern African Foundation for the Conservation of Coastal Birds) and the University of Exeter.

Please see full details in the attached pdf or this link.  Application deadline is 21 July. Please feel free to share this announcement with your colleagues or on your platforms.

Best regards,
Chris Oosthuizen
